operation_details.item: The user prefers extremely verbose prose paragraphs in workshop facilitation guides instead of timed agendas, exercises, or facilitator scripts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’m helping shape a workshop facilitation guide for an operations improvement session. Before I draft it, what kind of format tends to work best for you?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I prefer extremely verbose prose paragraphs that explain the flow and context in detail.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. So rather than a compact run-of-show, you’d like the guide to read more like a detailed narrative that a facilitator can absorb beforehand.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I don’t want it reduced to timed agendas, lists of exercises, or scripted facilitator lines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. I’ll focus on rich explanatory paragraphs: why each part matters, how the discussion might develop, and what connections the facilitator should keep in mind.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, and please leave room for judgment during the session instead of making it feel like everyone has to follow a rigid sequence.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For workshop facilitation guides, I want extremely verbose prose paragraphs instead of timed agendas, exercises, or facilitator scripts.
